title: The Bullet Ant's Sting Hurts for 24 Hours (Top of the Pain Scale)

scenes.text: This ant's sting hurts for a full day.
The bullet ant is only about an inch long.
Its sting scores a four on the Schmidt pain index, the top of the scale.
The scientist behind that scale compared it to walking over flaming charcoal with a three-inch nail in your heel.
It's named for the pain, which feels like being shot.
A full day of agony, from an insect weighing about a tenth of a gram.

description:
This ant's sting hurts for a full day.
The bullet ant scores a four, the top rating, on the Schmidt sting pain index.
Would you ever dare to touch one?
first_comment: Which would you pick: a bullet ant sting or a warrior wasp sting? Both rate a 4 on the Schmidt scale.
